# awscc_config_configuration_recorder (Resource)

Resource type definition for AWS::Config::ConfigurationRecorder



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role that allows AWS Config to read S3 objects.

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the configuration recorder. By default, AWS Config assigns the name "default" when creating the configuration recorder. To change the configuration recorder name, you must use the DeleteConfigurationRecorder action to delete your current configuration recorder, and then you must use the PutConfigurationRecorder command to create a configuration recorder that has the desired name.
- `recording_group` (Attributes) Specifies which resource types are in scope for the configuration recorder to record. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recording_group))
- `recording_mode` (Attributes) Specifies the default recording frequency for the configuration recorder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recording_mode))
- `started_on_create` (Boolean) Defaults to 'true'. Controls whether the recorder starts recording after the create operation. Set this to 'false' for development and testing purposes.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `resource_arn` (String) Returns the Amazon Resource Name (ARN) for the Configuration Recorder.

<a id="nestedatt--recording_group"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recording_group`

Optional:

- `all_supported` (Boolean) Specifies whether AWS Config records configuration changes for all supported resource types, excluding the global IAM resource types.
- `exclusion_by_resource_types` (Attributes) An object that specifies how AWS Config excludes resource types from being recorded by the configuration recorder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recording_group--exclusion_by_resource_types))
- `include_global_resource_types` (Boolean) This option is a bundle which only applies to the global IAM resource types: IAM users, groups, roles, and customer managed policies.
- `recording_strategy` (Attributes) An object that specifies the recording strategy for the configuration recorder. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recording_group--recording_strategy))
- `resource_types` (List of String) A comma-separated list that specifies which resource types AWS Config records.

<a id="nestedatt--recording_group--exclusion_by_resource_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recording_group.exclusion_by_resource_types`

Optional:

- `resource_types` (List of String) A comma-separated list of resource types to exclude from recording by the configuration recorder.


<a id="nestedatt--recording_group--recording_strategy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recording_group.recording_strategy`

Optional:

- `use_only` (String)



<a id="nestedatt--recording_mode"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recording_mode`

Optional:

- `recording_frequency` (String) The default recording frequency that AWS Config uses to record configuration changes.
- `recording_mode_overrides` (Attributes List) An array of 'RecordingModeOverride' objects for you to specify your overrides for the recording mode. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recording_mode--recording_mode_overrides))

<a id="nestedatt--recording_mode--recording_mode_overrides"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recording_mode.recording_mode_overrides`

Optional:

- `description` (String) A description that you provide for the override.
- `recording_frequency` (String) The recording frequency that will be applied to all the resource types specified in the override.
- `resource_types` (List of String) A comma-separated list that specifies which resource types AWS Config includes in the override.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_config_configuration_recorder.example
  identity = {
    name = "name"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the configuration recorder

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_config_configuration_recorder.example
  id = "name"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_config_configuration_recorder.example "name"
```
